evaluate_evolved_program: run the evaluator to compare an evolved FFT solution against the AlgoTune baseline and measure speedup
evaluate_stage1_basic_check: run the first stage evaluation to check if an evolved program has basic functionality and runs without errors
evaluate_stage2_full_test: run the second stage evaluation to perform thorough baseline comparison testing on an evolved program
calculate_speedup_ratio: calculate the speedup ratio between a baseline implementation time and an evolved solution time in milliseconds
run_function_with_timeout: run any function with a configurable timeout using a thread pool executor and raise TimeoutError on expiry
